description: FileForceCloseHandles addresses a file as /{shareName}/{directory}/{fileName}, so a file at the share root (empty directory) becomes /share//file and fails InvalidResourceName. Address it by one greedy fileName path relative to the share root (dir/sub/file.txt) and drop the directory label.

patches.value: Path of the target file relative to the share root, e.g. `reports/2026/q1.csv`; `/` separates directories.
